note: **2 Pelham Cottage, Barrack Lane, schedule 206 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Arthur William Smith, joiner, bound to the cabinet maker the record already held. The page numbers the Pelham Cottages, so there are at least two, and neither is in the property list - this household is unfiled beside number 1.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A

census.source: 1939 Register, schedule 206, 2 Pelham Cottage, Barrack Lane, ED letter code RMGB, Nottingham registration district 430-3, sub-district 26, The National Archives RG101/6178A - read from the page by A. Hagues; sub number 1; the index gives him as Arthur W; he is the Arthur William Smith the record holds as a cabinet maker, born 1869, on Pelham Crescent in 1901 and in the 1911 and 1921 rounds, and joiner is the same trade. The page writes the address in full as 2 Pelham Cott Barrack Lane, at RG101/6178A, item 20, line 5 - so the Pelham Cottages are numbered and there are at least two
